# An empty clause section

`Policy: pol-BLNK` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

The Clauses heading is present and nothing follows it. Two checks are looking at that blank: `empty-section`, which
holds every declared section to carrying something, and `clause-table`, which knows what belongs here.

## Scope

This fixture only. It pins the one finding, so that a heading with no table under it is reported by the check that can
name what is missing.
